```{r setup}
#| code-summary: "Setup: load and clean the release"
source(here::here("common.R"))

scores_all <- load_levante_latest("scores")
scores <- load_levante_clean()
cleaning <- attr(scores, "cleaning")
data_ref <- unique(scores_all$redivis_source)
last_run <- as.Date(max(scores$time_started, na.rm = TRUE))

# datasets ordered by number of children, for every plot below
ds_order <- scores |> distinct(dataset, user_id) |> count(dataset, sort = TRUE)
by_ds <- \(df) df |>
  mutate(dataset_label = factor(dataset_labels_named[dataset],
                                levels = rev(dataset_labels_named[ds_order$dataset])))

# waves: a child's runs of one task count as separate waves when they are at
# least 90 days apart
wave_gap <- 90
waves <- add_waves(scores, min_gap = wave_gap)
child_waves <- waves |>
  group_by(dataset, user_id) |>
  summarise(waves = max(wave), .groups = "drop")

n_children <- n_distinct(scores$user_id)
n_long <- sum(child_waves$waves >= 2)
long_ds <- child_waves |>
  filter(waves >= 2) |>
  count(dataset, sort = TRUE) |>
  filter(n >= 20)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Summary

**Data:** `r data_ref`, runs through `r format(last_run, "%Y-%m-%d")`.

- The release has `r fmt_n(nrow(scores))` scored runs from
  `r fmt_n(n_children)` children in `r n_distinct(scores$dataset)` datasets
  and `r n_distinct(scores$task_id)` tasks.
- `r fmt_n(n_long)` children have runs of at least one task in two or more
  waves, in `r nrow(long_ds)` datasets with 20 or more such children.
- Of the runs production did not exclude,
  `r fmt_pct(1 - pick(cleaning, runs, step == "Valid but unscored") / sum(is.na(scores_all$exclusion)), 1)`
  carry a score, and `r fmt_n(sum(is.na(scores$age)))` scored runs have no
  age.
:::

# Who is in the release

```{r children-by-dataset, fig.height=5}
#| label: fig-children
#| fig-cap: "Children with at least one scored run, by dataset."
kids <- scores |>
  group_by(dataset) |>
  summarise(children = n_distinct(user_id), runs = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  by_ds()

ggplot(kids, aes(x = children, y = dataset_label, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = fmt_n(children)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_dataset(guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "Children with at least one scored run", y = NULL)
```

```{r age-by-dataset, fig.height=6}
#| label: fig-ages
#| fig-cap: "Children's age at their first run, by dataset."
first_age <- scores |>
  filter(!is.na(age)) |>
  group_by(dataset, user_id) |>
  summarise(age = min(age), .groups = "drop") |>
  by_ds()

ggplot(first_age, aes(x = age, y = dataset_label, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_dataset(guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 16, 2)) +
  labs(x = "Age at first run (years)", y = NULL)
```

```{r coverage, fig.height=6.5}
#| label: fig-coverage
#| fig-cap: "Scored runs of each task in each dataset."
coverage <- scores |>
  count(dataset, task_label, name = "runs") |>
  by_ds()

ggplot(coverage, aes(x = task_label, y = dataset_label, fill = runs)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = fmt_n(runs), colour = runs > 100), size = 3.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "white"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
```

# Repeat assessments

A child's runs of one task count as separate waves when they are at least
`r wave_gap` days apart.

```{r waves, fig.height=5}
#| label: fig-waves
#| fig-cap: "Children by the number of waves of any task, by dataset."
wave_share <- child_waves |>
  mutate(waves = factor(pmin(waves, 3), 1:3, c("1 wave", "2 waves", "3 or more"))) |>
  count(dataset, waves) |>
  by_ds()

ggplot(wave_share, aes(x = n, y = dataset_label, fill = waves)) +
  geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Children", y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r wave-gaps, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-wave-gaps
#| fig-cap: "Months between a child's first and second wave of a task, for datasets with 20 or more children in two waves."
gaps <- waves |>
  filter(wave == 2, gap >= wave_gap) |>
  semi_join(long_ds, by = "dataset") |>
  by_ds()

ggplot(gaps, aes(x = gap / 30.4, y = dataset_label, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_dataset(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Months between a child's first and second wave of a task", y = NULL)
```

The datasets with 20 or more children in two or more waves are
`r paste(dataset_labels_named[long_ds$dataset], collapse = ", ")`.

# Exclusions and cleaning

Production marks runs it could not score with an exclusion reason.

```{r exclusions, fig.height=5}
#| label: fig-exclusions
#| fig-cap: "Share of each dataset's runs that production excluded, by reason."
excl <- scores_all |>
  mutate(status = coalesce(exclusion, "kept")) |>
  count(dataset, status) |>
  group_by(dataset) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(status != "kept") |>
  mutate(status = str_replace_all(status, "_", " ")) |>
  by_ds()

ggplot(excl, aes(x = share, y = dataset_label, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Share of the dataset's runs excluded by production", y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

The pages in the monitor use `clean_levante_latest()` (`common.R`), which
removes these runs and a few more (@tbl-cleaning):

```{r cleaning}
#| label: tbl-cleaning
#| tbl-cap: "Runs removed by `clean_levante_latest()`."
cleaning |>
  mutate(runs = fmt_n(runs)) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Removed", "Runs"), align = "lr")
```

The ROAR-Word rule removes runs with accuracy below .4 or a median response
time under 500 ms ([ROAR-Word engagement study](../studies/2026-07_roar-word-engagement/roar_word.qmd)).

# Missing information

What share of runs carry the information the other pages rely on: a score,
an age, and whether the adaptive or fixed form was used. Gaps here are
passed to the data team.

```{r scored-share, fig.height=4.5}
#| label: fig-scored-share
#| fig-cap: "Share of each dataset's runs that production did not exclude and that have a score. A dataset well below 100% has runs whose scores were not computed."
scored_share <- scores_all |>
  filter(is.na(exclusion)) |>
  group_by(dataset) |>
  summarise(valid = n(), scored = mean(!is.na(score)), .groups = "drop") |>
  by_ds()

ggplot(scored_share, aes(x = scored, y = dataset_label, colour = dataset)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_colour_dataset(guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(NA, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Share of non-excluded runs with a score", y = NULL)
```

```{r check-table}
#| label: tbl-missing
#| tbl-cap: "Runs missing information."
checks <- tibble(
  check = c("Non-excluded runs without a score",
            "Runs with more than one score",
            "Scored runs without an age",
            "Scored runs without an adaptive flag"),
  runs = c(pick(cleaning, runs, step == "Valid but unscored"),
           pick(cleaning, runs, step == "More than one score"),
           sum(is.na(scores$age)),
           sum(is.na(scores$adaptive))))

unscored <- scores_all |>
  filter(is.na(exclusion), is.na(score)) |>
  left_join(task_lookup |> select(task_id, task_label), by = "task_id") |>
  count(dataset, task_label, sort = TRUE)

no_age <- scores |>
  filter(is.na(age)) |>
  count(dataset, sort = TRUE)

checks |>
  mutate(runs = fmt_n(runs)) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Check", "Runs"), align = "lr")
```

Unscored runs are concentrated in
`r unscored$task_label[1]` (`r fmt_n(sum(unscored$n[unscored$task_label == unscored$task_label[1]]))`
of `r fmt_n(sum(unscored$n))`), and runs without an age are all in
`r paste(dataset_labels_named[no_age$dataset], collapse = ", ")`.

```{r score-se, fig.height=4.5}
#| label: fig-score-se
#| fig-cap: "Standard errors of the scores, by task."
se <- scores |>
  filter(!is.na(score_se)) |>
  mutate(task_label = reorder(task_label, score_se, median))

ggplot(se, aes(x = score_se, y = task_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, width = 0.6) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 2)) +
  labs(x = "Standard error of the score (ability scale)", y = NULL)
```

ROAR-Sentence has no standard error; its score is a rate.

# Revision history

- **2026-10-30.** This page replaces "00 — Load data" and "01 — Data
  integrity audit", which ran on the 2026-08-31 per-site drafts. Their
  June-era checks (missing adaptive flags, duplicate ToM rows, artifacts of
  the v1.0 scoring bug) no longer apply to the pinned release and are not
  carried over. Cleaning now lives in `clean_levante_latest()` in
  `common.R`. Both old pages are in `archive/`.
